translation.name: Baibal Olcim
translation.englishName: Matupi Chin Standard Bible w/ Strongs

content.text: Hlang pakhat tah kuirhang la om tih hnokhoem a khueh. Te long te a khuehtawn a haeh pah dongah amah a khotoh nah
Te dongah anih te a khue tih
Nang kawng ka yaak he me tlam lae? Na hnokhoemnah dongkah olka te thuung laeh, na khoom ham na coeng voel moenih
a ti nah
Te vaengah hnokhoem amah te
Balae ka saii lah eh? Ka boeipa loh hnokhoemnah he kai lamloh a lat coeng, diklai daeng ham khaw ka noeng pawh, bih ham khaw ka yak
Ka saii ham te ka ming coeng. Te daengah ni hnokhoemnah lamkah ka puen uh vaengah a im khuila kai n'doe uh eh
a ti
Te dongah, a boeipa kah purhong rhoek te rhip a khue tih, lamhma taengah
Ka boeipa taengah meyet na ba
a ti nah
Te long te
Situi um yakhat
a ti nah. Te vaengah anih te
Na cabu na doe vaengah ngol pahoi lamtah sawmnga mah daek
a ti nah
Pakhat te khaw
Nang tah meyet na ba
a ti nah. Te long te
Cang phueih yakhat
a ti nah. Anih te
Cabu na doe vaengah sawmrhet la daek
a ti nah
A thai a lai neh a saii dongah boethae kah hnokhoem te boeipa loh a koeh. Ta kumhal kah ca rhoek he amah cadil khuiah tah vangnah kah a ca rhoek lakah cueih uh
Te dongah kai loh nangmih taengah ka thui
Boethae laikhuehtawn te khaw na paya la khuehuh. Te daengah ni dungyan dap khuila na khum vaengah n'doe uh eh
A yit dongah uepom la aka om tah a len dongah khaw uepom la om tih, a yit dongah aka halang tah a len dongah khaw halang
Halang, laikhuehtawn neh uepom la na om uh pawt bal atah unim nangmih rhep aka tangnah
Te dongah na hlanglang tih uepom la na om pawt atah na koe te u long nangmih m'paek eh

Imkhut pakhat loh boei panit kah sal a bi thai moenih, pakhat te a toeng vetih pakhat te a lungnah ni, pakhat te a talong vetih pakhat te a hnoel ni. Pathen neh laikhuehtawn kah sal na bi rhenthen thai moenih

content: Te te naivoei la aka om Pharisee rhoek loh boeih a yaak uh vaengah amah te a nueih thiluh.

content.text: Nangmih loh hlang hmaiah aka tang la na omuh. Tedae Pathen loh nangmih thinko te a ming. Hlang soah aka sang te Pathen hmaiah tueilaehnah la om
Olkhueng neh tonghma rhoek loh Johan hil, te lamkah loh Pathen kah ram tah ana phong coeng tih a khuila la boeih ana ael uh
Olkhueng te a dek pakhat a rhul lakah vaan neh diklai a khum te a phoeng la om pueng
A yuu te a tueih tih a tloe aka lo boeih tah samphaih coeng. Te phoeiah va aka ma aka yunah te khaw samphaih
Hlang pakhat tah kuirhang la om. Te dongah daidi, hnithen neh khuk uh tih hnin takuem thayoei tuipan la a uum
Te vaengah khodaeng pakhat, a ming ah Lazarus tah buhlut neh a vongka ah a yalh pah
Te dongah kuirhang caboei lamkah aka bo nen te bunghah khaw a nai. Tedae ui rhoek long pataeng ha pawk uh vaengah a buhlut te a laeh pa uh
Tedae khodaeng te a duek vaengah puencawn rhoek loh Abraham rhang dongla a khuen. Te phoeiah kuirhang te khaw duek tih a up uh
Tedae saelkhui ah a mik a hoh tih nganboh neh kho a sak vaengah tah Abraham neh a rhang dongkah Lazarus te a hla lamkah a hmuh
Te dongah a pang neh
A pa Abraham, kai he n'rhen lamtah Lazarus te han tueih mai. A kutdawn kah a hmoicue te tui dongah naek saeh lamtah ka lai he sul sak saeh, hmaitak khuiah mat n
yuek coeng he
a ti nah
Tedae Abraham loh
Camoe, na hingnah dongkah na hnothen na dang te poek. Te vaengah Lazarus tah yoethae bangla om. Tedae anih a mong vaengah he nang tah patang loh n
yuek coeng

He rhoek boeih khuiah khaw kaimih neh nangmih laklo kah longhoi tah muep n'lak coeng. Te dongah nangmih taengla hlaikan dingdoeng aka ngaih long khaw coeng pawh, kaimih taengla hlaikan dingdoeng ham khaw coeng pawh
a ti nah
Te phoeiah
A pa namah ni kan hloep. Te dongah anih te a pa im la tueih mai
Manuca panga ka khueh dongah amih te uen mai saeh. Te daengah ni amih khaw hekah nganboh hmuen la ha pawk uh pawt eh?
a ti nah
Tedae Abraham loh
Moses neh tonghma te a khueh uh ta, amih taengah hnatun uh saeh
a ti nah
Tedae te long te
Moenih, a pa Abraham, aka duek tangtae pakhat loh amih te paan koinih yut uh ni
a ti nah
Tedae anih te
Moses neh tonghma rhoek kah olthui te a hnatun uh pawt atah, duek khui lamkah khat khat thoo cakhaw ngaitang mahpawh
a ti nah
